settings.enable_cross.label: Enable Crosshair
settings.enable_cross.description: Whether the overlay aims with a crosshair.
settings.enable_windows_selection.label: Enable Window Detection
settings.enable_windows_selection.descri: Allow clicking a window to select its whole region, on compositors that can report window geometry.
settings.screenshot_editor.label: Screenshot Annotation Tool
settings.screenshot_editor.description: Command run on a right-click selection, as <tool> -f <in> -o <out>. Needs to be pre-installed; satty gets its own flag names.
settings.keep_source_screenshot.label: Keep Source Screenshot
settings.keep_source_screenshot.descript: Keep the *_source.png the editor was given, next to the file it saved.
settings.save_path.label: Screenshot Save Folder
settings.recording_save_path.label: Recording Save Folder
settings.recording_save_path.description: Folder where screen recordings are written.
settings.png_compression_level.label: PNG Compression Level
settings.png_compression_level.descripti: PNG compression level (0=fastest, 9=smallest). Higher values take longer to write; lower values are faster and produce bigger files, which can make copying to the clipboard fail.
settings.notifications_enabled.label: Enable Notifications
settings.notifications_enabled.descripti: Show success notifications for screenshots, OCR and recording. Missing tools and failures are always reported.
settings.recording_notifications.label: Recording Notifications
settings.recording_notifications.descrip: Show notifications when a recording starts or stops.
